catalog.observed: Both locales announced the governing controls and verified result. The driver retained literal mixed-script text and immutable history.

submit.observed: Both requests preserved the exact bound operation and submitted result. The reader announced the actual reason and preview controls.

approve.observed: Both locales used separate authenticated requester and reviewer contexts. Self-decision returned 403, and the reader announced the separate effect gates after approval.

expiry-replan.observed: Both locales announced actual expiry. The driver verified blocked dispatch, the next revision, a new effect and no carryover of decisions. Native supplementary readbacks captured the retained revise fields.

unknown-recovery.observed: Both locales announced the durable unknown and no blind retry. Recovery used a positive receipt with the same operation, and a repeated request did not add history.

locale-fallback.observed: The unsupported locale fell back to English. Both language round trips preserved frozen material and did not send mutations. The screenshots show RTL placement and invariant identifiers.

keyboard-focus.observed: The actual browser recorded the Tab/Shift+Tab checks and both native window returns. Original input node, value, focus and authenticated scope survived both returns.

semantics-at.observed: NVDA/eSpeak logged headings, labelled controls, status and recovery announcements in both locales. The excerpts retain stage and reader provenance.

contrast.observed: The operator inspected the captured bilingual states and verified measured contrast. The project owner explicitly approved the human contrast review of the captured W79 evidence.

mobile-reflow.observed: The operator inspected both 320 CSS pixel layouts and visible language focus. The CI scan widths matched the viewports and the scoped navigation retained its own scrolling.

preferences.observed: The browser exercised reduced motion and forced colors. The operator inspected the captured forced-color and enlarged-spacing states.

limitations: AI operator reviewed screenshots. Human visual review remains pending.
Vendor speech logs establish output and language markers. Pronunciation and community translation quality were not audited.
Browser-emulated preferences do not establish physical OS preference behavior.
